probes.name: default_return
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, part As Object
Dim sourceText As String
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
sourceText = ""
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Helpers"
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Type InnerData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Value As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Type" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Public Type RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Value As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Nested As InnerData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Items(0 To 1) As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Type" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "" & vbCrLf
part.CodeModule.AddFromString sourceText
sourceText = ""
Set part = target.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "Caller"
sourceText = sourceText & "Function MakeRecord() As RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Function" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Function Check() As Long" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Dim item As Helpers.RecordData" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "item = MakeRecord()" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "Check = item.Value" & vbCrLf
sourceText = sourceText & "End Function" & vbCrLf
part.CodeModule.AddFromString sourceText
Probe = CStr(Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!Caller.Check"))
target.Close False
End Function
